elements.name: Add and remove a quick access command

steps.name: a part document is active in the MCAD Software
the quick access toolbar is above the ribbon
Print is not present on the toolbar
New, Open, Save, Undo, Redo and Home are present on the toolbar
the user opens the quick access customization menu
Print is unchecked
New, Open, Save, Undo, Redo and Home are checked
the user selects Print
a Print icon appears on the quick access toolbar
the user reopens the customization menu
Print is checked
the user selects Print again
the Print icon is removed from the toolbar
the same part remains active

elements.name: Move the quick access toolbar below and above the ribbon

steps.name: a part document is active in the MCAD Software
the quick access toolbar is above the ribbon
Print is visible on the toolbar
the user opens the quick access customization menu
the user chooses Show Below the Ribbon
the quick access toolbar appears in a row below the ribbon
Print remains visible on the toolbar
the user reopens the customization menu
Print is checked
Show Above the Ribbon is offered
the user chooses Show Above the Ribbon
the quick access toolbar returns above the ribbon
the same part remains active

elements.name: Add and remove a ribbon command through its context menu

steps.name: a part document is active in the MCAD Software
Extrude is available on the 3D Model ribbon
Extrude is not on the quick access toolbar
the user right-clicks Extrude on the ribbon
its context menu offers Add to Quick Access Toolbar
the user chooses Add to Quick Access Toolbar
an Extrude icon appears on the quick access toolbar
Extrude remains available on the ribbon
the user right-clicks the added quick access icon
its context menu offers Remove from Quick Access Toolbar
the user chooses Remove from Quick Access Toolbar
the added icon disappears from the quick access toolbar
Extrude remains available on the ribbon
the same part remains active

elements.name: Add a separator from a toolbar command context menu

steps.name: a part document is active in the MCAD Software
Extrude has been added to the quick access toolbar
the user right-clicks its quick access icon
the context menu offers Add Separator
the user chooses Add Separator
the quick access row gains a narrow divider beside the added command
the same part remains active

elements.name: Invoke an added command from quick access in an empty part

steps.name: an empty part is active in the MCAD Software
Extrude has been added to the quick access toolbar
the 3D Model ribbon is active
the user selects the Extrude quick access icon
the workspace displays the origin planes for selection
Start 2D Sketch is highlighted on the ribbon
the user presses Escape
the origin plane selection display closes
the empty part remains active

elements.name: Invoke an added shortcut while another ribbon tab is active

steps.name: an empty part is active in the MCAD Software
Extrude has been added to the quick access toolbar from 3D Model
the user selects the View ribbon tab
the Extrude quick access icon remains visible
the user selects the Extrude quick access icon
the origin planes are displayed for selection
the View ribbon remains displayed
the user presses Escape
the origin plane selection display closes
the empty part remains active

elements.name: Show a part shortcut in part documents but not an assembly

steps.name: two parts and an assembly are open in the MCAD Software
the first part is active
Extrude has been added to the quick access toolbar from its ribbon
the user activates the assembly document
the Extrude shortcut is not shown on its quick access toolbar
the user reactivates the first part
the Extrude shortcut is visible again
the user activates the second part
the Extrude shortcut is visible there as well
the second part remains active

elements.name: Disable the add option for an existing shortcut

steps.name: a part is active in the MCAD Software
Extrude is not on the quick access toolbar
the user right-clicks Extrude on the ribbon
Add to Quick Access Toolbar is enabled
the user chooses Add to Quick Access Toolbar
the user right-clicks Extrude on the ribbon again
Add to Quick Access Toolbar is disabled
the user dismisses the menu and remove the Extrude quick access icon
the user right-clicks Extrude on the ribbon again
Add to Quick Access Toolbar is enabled

elements.name: Keep a standard shortcut selection when switching document contexts

steps.name: a part and an assembly are open in the MCAD Software
Print is not selected in either document's quick access customization menu
the user activates the part and selects Print in its quick access customization menu
Print appears on the part's quick access toolbar
the user activates the assembly
Print is absent from the assembly's quick access toolbar
the user opens its quick access customization menu
Print is unchecked
the user returns to the part
Print is visible on the part's quick access toolbar
the user opens its quick access customization menu
Print is checked
the user selects Print again
Print is removed from the part's quick access toolbar

elements.name: Show Redo disabled when no redo action is available

steps.name: a part document is active in the MCAD Software
Redo is present on the quick access toolbar
no redo action is available in the active document
the user inspects the quick access toolbar
Redo remains visible but disabled
the active part remains open

elements.name: Open and close the Material Browser from quick access

steps.name: a part document is active in the MCAD Software
the Tools ribbon is selected
the Material Browser quick access command is visible
the Material Browser window is closed
the user selects the Material Browser quick access command
the Material Browser window opens over the part workspace
the part remains active
the user closes the Material Browser window
the browser window closes
the Tools ribbon and active part remain visible
